stage: Feasibility only, before inspecting SAM2 semantic scores
selection: First eight images of the already fixed full-rate development index, all currently supported detector instances; no GT masks or boxes
controls: Same SAM2 encoded image, same current detector-mask bounding boxes, same pretrained weights. Current arm clears memory every frame; temporal arm reads strictly previous native recurrent mask features and object pointers.
bounds: 128 tracks, 2s absent-track expiry, six recent spatial memories plus initial conditioning memory, original bounded object-pointer history, batch at most four. Reset on camera gap >0.75s or visual session change.
scope: No GT or future image input; no semantic or identity accuracy claim from this probe. Native SAM2 mask-feedback is intentional, unlike the older raw-only semantic probability bank.
runtime_gate: SAM-only image encoder + temporal readout/memory update/postprocessing p95 <=50ms excluding frame zero. First-frame, paired-control cost, startup and peak allocation separately reported. Passing still requires full ROS latency and data accuracy checks.
if_failed: Do not launch the full 1857-image semantic comparison or enable default deployment. Preserve measured failure rather than claim the official A100 FPS applies locally.
